title: Print the board sign
prompt: Print three lines, exactly: Task board, then Open: 3, then Done: 1. The starter prints the first line.
hints: How many lines must print, and how many does the starter print?
Each line needs its own Console.WriteLine statement with the text in double quotes.
Add a statement that prints Open: 3 and another that prints Done: 1. Keep the colon and the space.
checkLabels: The output must be Task board, Open: 3 and Done: 1 on three lines.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Puts all three parts in one printed line.
Leaves out the punctuation the output needs.

feedback: Count your printed lines and compare each with the prompt. The colon and the single space after it are part of the text.
